display.title: Episode 463: Three Lost on an Island, Chapter 1
display.summary_short: At a time of danger Uncle Yossi teaches how achdus brings shalom, begins the tale of three shipwreck survivors on a deserted island, and tells how Rabbi Levi Yitzchak of Berditchev saw only good.
display.summary_long: Broadcast at a time when Jews everywhere were praying for Hashem's mercy and for peace. Uncle Yossi teaches that the way to bring shalom is achdus and Ahavas Yisroel, and gives the example of Aharon HaKohen, who loved peace and pursued it by quietly bringing quarreling people back together. After the Hakochainik march, a yeshiva student leads the Shema and Uncle Yossi explains that a true chayal (soldier) is a Chassid, a yarei Shamayim and a lamdan; everyone gives tzedakah. Story time begins 'Three Lost on an Island', a parable about life itself: a doctor, a scientist and an engineer survive a shipwreck. The doctor finds a healing apple, the scientist builds a telescope and the engineer repairs an abandoned airplane. Then the scientist sees something astonishing through his telescope, to be revealed next week. A second story tells how Rabbi Levi Yitzchak of Berditchev saw a man greasing his wagon in tallis and tefillin and praised him for davening even while he worked. Listeners say Tehillim in his merit, and the show ends with a call to say the Twelve Pesukim.
display.lesson: Love peace and pursue it like Aharon HaKohen, and always judge others favorably as Rabbi Levi Yitzchak of Berditchev did.
